title: server: serve the target's name and id for a `referenceNameVisible` lookup when the caller cannot read the target (#29171 ruling B)
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmPi25XXKx92Xmg4viS

Filing gate: ③ follow-up the ruling assigns. Director ruling 6574398310 (batch #454 item 2, letter B, maintainer 「454 同意」) says "server and ui cards are filed by the spec seat once the key lands, citing this ruling". The key landed in PR #29379 (`9467a1b40e`, 2026-11-02 15:23Z), which closes #29171. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.
Reader: `domain:server`, the objectql / REST read and `$expand` path.

## What is declared and not served

`FieldSchema.referenceNameVisible` (`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` ≈L1731) is an optional boolean on `lookup` and `user` fields only, default off, refused on every other type. Its describe opens `[PLANNED — not yet served]`. Today a caller who can read the referencing record but not the target gets the restricted-record posture: no name and no id (objectui#13335's 「受限记录」).

## What the ruling binds (verbatim scope)

- When a field declares `referenceNameVisible: true` and the caller can read the referencing record but **cannot** read the target, the engine returns the target's **name and id, nothing else**.
- `$expand` on that field returns the same: name + id, never other fields.
- `displayField` does not widen it.
- The same key covers `sys_user` names, through `user` fields and through lookups to `sys_user`. There is no separate carve-out.
- A caller who **can** read the target gets exactly what it gets today.
- Placement is the referencing field. No target-object switch.

## Readings the contract review asked the implementer to take from ADR-0079 D4

- Resolve the display name through `nameField ?? displayNameField ?? derivation`, with the floor `Record #id`, not a literal `nameField` read.
- A `multiple: true` lookup returns name + id per element.

## Done when

- The read and `$expand` branches serve name + id under the conditions above. A test pins each condition with a control: the field without the key stays restricted, a readable target is unchanged, and an `$expand` of another field returns nothing extra.
- The `planned` marker on the key flips to served. Add or flip the liveness row in `packages/spec/liveness/field.json` citing the server test. That one spec edit is owed to the spec lane, or rides with a seat-agreed surface amendment.
- Hand the ui card (filed beside this one) the response shape it renders.

Ruling-ref: 6574398310 · parent #29171 · key PR #29379.
